blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro on Sunday said the prosecution team will formally state its position before the Senate impeachment court following the prosecution panel’s reported plan to drop an impeachment charge against Vice President Sara Duterte. Manila Rep. Joel Chua bared early Sunday that prosecutors will no longer present the bribery charge hinged on the testimony of former Department of Education (DepEd) officials who said they received cash envelopes through Duterte’s subordinate. “Our responsibility remains clear: to follow the evidence and bring a focused, well-supported case to its conclusion,” Luistro said in a statement. “That responsibility guides every […]...
